purpose: supplied-reference alignment truth on inspected development data; no fits or scores
identity_definition: native minimap2 2.30 mlen/blen; threshold unchanged; not matches/CIGAR columns
native_validation: all rows before filtering: exact axes, endpoints, =XID CIGAR, columns=blen+nn, 0<=equal-mlen<=nn, remaining nn<=X+I+D, NM=columns-mlen; typed unique cg/nn/NM tags required
ambiguous_base_policy: a qualifying nn>0 alignment vetoes its whole query span globally, even against clean support; no base in that span supplies purity, a contig label or reference recovery; exact nn localization is unavailable from PAF alone
nonqualifying_rows: validated completely; supply no support or veto under the unchanged identity/aligned-bp thresholds
query_support: qualifying nn=0 =/X paired bases only, excluding insertions, deletions, vetoed spans and cross-genome ambiguity
locus_support: unique canonical molecule-coordinate mapping after global competition; same-genome multiple loci count for genome purity only
circular_policy: verify catalog file and sequence hashes; require each alias to be an exact unique forward rotation of the first record; normalize modulo length and split wrap intervals on either query strand; keep distinct actual genomic repeats unresolved
genome_identity: exact accepted positive origin genome ID by source-file join; HOST is metadata only; zero-origin files get distinct zero_origin:: names and remain competitors
denominator: all provided records of every positive bacterial/archaeal genome >=200kb, including unobserved records; count circular aliases once; retain non-target and zero-origin DNA as competitors
limitations: all emitted qualifying chains from a heuristic aligner, not exhaustive homology
conservative whole-span nn quarantine can reduce attributable support
provided MAG/scaffold lengths are not finished-genome completeness or formal MAG quality
no near-genome or pretraining independence established
truth labels are evaluator inputs only and must never enter feature/training paths
